scope: M2 pageerror events and typed listeners/waits for the main page session and same-process child frames. Functional verification only; no performance or release claim.

contract.values: A native JavaScript Error with the pinned reference name, message and exact browser stack. Original event JSON preserves lone UTF-16 surrogates through Rust. No additional renderer evaluation is needed.
contract.ownership: Deliver only to the live published page matching the originating browser session, independently of pending operations. Caught/evaluated exceptions are excluded. No error history is retained by the engine/client.
contract.bounds: The original CDP event remains subject to the ordinary 8 MiB browser event cap. Its JSON-text envelope is subject to the negotiated application control-frame cap (8 MiB default, 32 KiB in the fault fixture). Oversized output emits a bounded global ResourceLimitError and closes the stream; ownership cleanup is verified.

coverage: Twenty shared throws/rejections preserve names, messages and stacks: built-in and custom errors, multiline text, lone surrogates/NUL, custom/empty stacks, thrown primitives, objects, arrays, unhandled promises, a 20000-character message and syntax errors.

Nine shared lifecycle checks cover caught/evaluated exclusion, listener identity/once/predicates, predicate failure and timeout listener cleanup, events during pending evaluation, same-process child frames, successor navigation, page isolation, ordered 32-event bursts and close/sibling survival.
Packed fresh npm ESM/CommonJS consumers execute pageerror waits and typecheck inferred Error listeners; a negative type assertion prevents accidental any inference.

A 40000-lone-surrogate exception while evaluation is pending triggers the negotiated output limit, preserves ResourceLimitError and releases owned browser/profile resources on all three checked platforms/configurations.
